name: Structural frame
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: A load-bearing framework. No humanoid topology, body size, or minimum quantity is implied.

name: Articulated joint
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: Connects structural elements with permitted articulation.

name: Alchemical actuator
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: An actuating mechanism requiring compatible circulation.

name: Alchemical circulation assembly
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: Distributes the working medium needed by compatible alchemical actuators.

name: External casing
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: An outer covering whose mechanical protection depends on material and later authored design rules.

name: Manipulator
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: Provides a manipulatory interface once sufficient movement and control are available.

name: Integrated equipment mount
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: A mounting interface for integrated equipment. No attacks or equipment proficiency are granted by this definition.

name: Tether reel
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: An optional mechanism for deploying and retracting a tether; integration and operating-state rules remain subject to authoring.

name: Power-source housing
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional
description: A configurable housing for a selected power-source mechanism. Housing and source are separate installed definitions.

name: Limb assembly
description: Supports a configurable manipulator, locomotor or other appendage; no anatomical count or shape is required.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Sensory array
description: Supports a configurable sense or measurement subsystem; perception traits are not automatically granted.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Control module
description: A control and coordination interface for dependent assemblies; no automatic intelligence or creature consciousness is implied.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Mechanical transmission
description: Delivers motion from a compatible driving mechanism.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Ball joint
description: A multi-axis articulation alternative, dependent on suitable structural attachment.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Wing assembly
description: A wing-shaped support assembly that may be configured for authored locomotion or weapon use.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Locomotion unit
description: Generic ground locomotion support adaptable to different arrangements; it does not itself grant a speed. A provisional maximum gross supported load applies only while this unit is operational; multiple units share support only when the joint configuration is compatible.
rulesStatus: candidate walking speed tiers and gross-load capacity; unapproved balance parameters

name: Protective plating
description: A protective covering; armor values depend on later authored material, design and balancing rules.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Crystal eye
description: Crystal visual hardware described on Warforged; any sense or perception grant must be separately authored.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Docent interface
description: Interface for a docent-like control or coordination network; independent of the control source.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Auxiliary control node
description: A supporting control node for distributed systems.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Crew compartment
description: A compartment usable for carrying occupants when capacity and access are authored.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Passenger platform
description: A structural platform for carried passengers subject to size and capacity rules.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Armblade mount
description: Weapon mount inspired by Warforged armblades. No weapon damage is granted without an approved canonical rule.

name: Bolt launcher mount
description: Integrated projectile mounting for authored ranged equipment.

name: Javelin launcher mount
description: Mount for an authored javelin launching mechanism.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Heavy strike mount
description: Mount for a heavy integrated striking component, such as an axe or hammer configuration.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Eldritch turret mount
description: Mounting interface for an authored magical turret mechanism.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Energy emitter mount
description: Mounting interface for an authored beam or elemental projector.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Shield mount
description: Mounting interface for a shield or protective device.
rulesStatus: candidate physical design; recipe quantities and operating values provisional

name: Storage compartment
